rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something particular, specified, or designated.

example.english: Please fill in your name at the given spot.
example.traditional: 請喺指定位置填寫姓名。
example.jyutping: cing2 hai2 zi2 ding6 wai6 zi3 tin4 se2 sing3 meng2

rows.note: Use this for a time or arrangement that has already been agreed or fixed in advance.

example.english: We'll meet here at the given time on Saturday morning.
example.traditional: 我哋已經約定咗星期六朝早十點喺呢度見。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 joek3 ding6 zo2 sing1 kei4 luk6 ziu1 zou2 sap6 dim2 hai2 ni1 dou6 gin3

rows.note: Use this in formal or explanatory contexts for something treated as an assumption or hypothesis.

example.english: Given that all the data is correct, the plan will work.
example.traditional: 假定所有資料都正確，個計劃就行得通。
example.jyutping: gaa2 ding6 so2 jau5 zi1 liu2 dou1 zing3 kok3 go3 gai3 waak6 zau6 haang4 dak1 tung1

rows.note: Use this when “given to” means liable or prone to do something, rather than simply fond of it.

example.english: They are given to saying the wrong thing whenever they drink.
example.traditional: 佢一飲酒就容易講錯嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 jam2 zau2 zau6 jung4 ji6 gong2 co3 je5
